plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM (limma-trend)
plan.analytical_narrative: The core delivered only a gene-level Salmon TPM table (12000 genes x 12 samples) and a metadata table for a 6 lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single-batch design in human skin — no raw counts or quantification files exist, which rules out any count-based model (DESeq2/edgeR/voom). Per the grounded procedure for TPM/FPKM input, the plan: (1) QC's sample structure on log2(TPM+1) values via PCA/MDS and a sample-distance heatmap to check the lesional/control samples separate and to flag any outlier before modeling; (2) filters low-abundance genes (>=1 TPM in at least 6 samples, the smaller group size) and log2(TPM+1)-transforms the retained genes, with no count-style normalization since TPM already carries within-sample scaling; (3) fits a limma linear model with an explicit reference level (Control) and tests the Lesional-vs-Control contrast with limma-trend eBayes (robust=TRUE, trend=TRUE), selecting genes by BH-adjusted p<0.05; (4) takes the resulting significant gene list (or, if it falls short of about 50 genes, the full ranked gene list) into pathway enrichment against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, WikiPathways, and GO Biological Process gene sets using the tested genes as the enrichment universe, with rrvgo term reduction for GO and a stated size window (15-500); (5) produces a single report stating the design, the model, the thresholds, the number of genes tested and found DE, the enrichment databases and their versions, and a full reproducibility record (sessionInfo, package versions, collection versions). This routes psoriasis-relevant pathways (keratinocyte differentiation, immune/inflammatory signaling) without ever fabricating a count-based inference the data cannot support.

violations.message: DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm log fold change shrinkage is not a permitted method for qc_sample_structure in this situation.
permitted: Sample structure QC on log abundance values: MDS or PCA, sample distances, detected genes

violations.message: Low count filter: keep a gene with at least 10 counts in at least the smallest group size of samples is not a permitted method for filter_low_counts in this situation.
permitted: Low abundance filter on TPM, FPKM, or log expression values

violations.message: limma-voom with duplicateCorrelation for a blocking factor is forbidden in this situation.
permitted: limma linear model on log-scale expression values

violations.message: GO over-representation with clusterProfiler enrichGO and rrvgo term reduction is not a permitted method for enrichment in this situation.
permitted: Over-representation analysis with an explicit universe

flags.message: If fewer than about 50 genes pass the significance threshold, do not run an over-representation test on that list. A hypergeometric test of a short list finds no category, and a change of the threshold changes the list and the result. Run the ranked method on the full list of tested genes instead, because it finds a set of genes with a small but coordinated change that no single gene shows. State the size of the significant list in the report.
